context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3.7 badge editor + VIP border fix is fully verified. /app/backend/tests/test_badge_editor_phase37.py is the regression suite — it depends on the 3 system badge IDs being stable (founder=100c6158-..., vip=777f0add-..., verified=f1c0b7a6-...). One test (test_persists_across_backend_restart) issues `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` and sleeps ~5s — be aware if running in parallel.
rca of the issue: ORIGINAL BUG: VIP pill border stuck on green despite admin saves. ROOT CAUSE confirmed three-fold and all three fixes verified: (1) PATCH was 403-ing locked badges even for stealth — fixed by `_is_stealth(current)` bypass in update_badge. (2) seed_default_badges() was running on every boot and OVERWRITING border_color/bg_color/etc — fixed to only backfill MISSING keys; verified via `restart backend` + check border_color survives. (3) BadgeEditor UI exposed only Color/Gradient/Glow — now exposes Color/Background/Border/Text/Glow/Gradient with clearable affordances. All confirmed via real UI flow + 19 pytest cases.
